claims.statement: In current-gen 2K22 community roster editing OSSMID names an Off Screen Shooting Midrange tendency
A specific off-screen shooting preference may participate in rendered-game action choice, but no exact PC22 consumer proved
Off-screen mid and other mid-zone preferences are treated separately in historical player data
Later MyTEAM comments about screening/fading are contradictory and not transferable to 2K22

conflicts: User-roster naming is not evidence that PLAYER+0x46C reads the named UI field
An off-screen midrange decision may be mediated by Coach Run Plays, off-ball screen availability, shot type and defender positioning
PS5 CPU-versus-CPU or later MyTEAM anecdote cannot prove current-gen PC22 engine weight
